limitations: FPGA LUT, REG, BRAM, URAM, and DSP counts are complete post-route accelerator footprints on U55C.
The mm2 projection covers allocated BRAM/URAM bit capacity only and scales two CACTI-P 32 nm SRAM characterizations linearly by byte capacity.
The projection excludes logic, DSP, interconnect, clock tree, I/O, shell, and physical macro overhead differences; it is not full accelerator-core ASIC area.
Spine and GraSU+ReGraph builds are not iso-functional, so area ratios are descriptive rather than a normalized efficiency claim.
